description: Header file defining structures, constants, and function prototypes for Bluetooth ISO connection streams and groups in the Zephyr project.

methods.name: lll_conn_iso_done
methods.description: Handles completion of ISO connection events.

methods.name: lll_conn_iso_flush
methods.description: Flushes a specific ISO connection stream.

methods.name: ull_conn_iso_lll_stream_get_by_group
methods.description: Retrieves ISO streams associated with a group.

methods.name: ull_conn_iso_lll_stream_sorted_get_by_group
methods.description: Retrieves sorted ISO streams within a group.

methods.name: ull_conn_iso_lll_group_get_by_stream
methods.description: Gets the group associated with a specific ISO stream.

methods.name: ull_conn_iso_lll_stream_get
methods.description: Gets an ISO stream by handle.

methods.name: ll_iso_rx_put
methods.description: Puts received ISO data into the receive queue.
